# Generated by ppc finalize (job_room.py); do not edit by hand.
# Location scope, once, a day into a new game (on_action/pp_job_room.txt). When a new game starts the engine sizes
# every class to its room while no building has workers yet, and without workers a building gives none of the
# room back that its people take (job_room.py). This does the fill for those jobs: per class, the open jobs of the
# location's buildings are filled from its peasants, every peasant pop giving the same share (read one class
# after the other, each over the peasants left). Culture and religion as in the engine's own fill: those of the
# class's largest pop here; where it has none, the owner's for an upper class, the peasants' own otherwise.
pp_job_room_restore = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = pp_job_room_location
	# burghers
	if = {
		limit = { pp_job_room_share_burghers > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_job_room_share value = pp_job_room_share_burghers }
		if = {
			limit = { any_pop = { pop_type = pop_type:burghers } }
			ordered_pop = {
				limit = { pop_type = pop_type:burghers }
				order_by = pop_size
				max = 1
				save_temporary_scope_as = pp_job_room_like
			}
			every_pop = {
				limit = { pop_type = pop_type:peasants }
				split_pop = { fraction = scope:pp_job_room_share type = pop_type:burghers culture = scope:pp_job_room_like.culture religion = scope:pp_job_room_like.religion }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = owner }
			every_pop = {
				limit = { pop_type = pop_type:peasants }
				split_pop = { fraction = scope:pp_job_room_share type = pop_type:burghers culture = scope:pp_job_room_location.owner.culture religion = scope:pp_job_room_location.owner.religion }
			}
		}
		else = {
			every_pop = {
				limit = { pop_type = pop_type:peasants }
				split_pop = { fraction = scope:pp_job_room_share type = pop_type:burghers }
			}
		}
	}
	remove_variable = pp_job_room_done_burghers
}

# Location scope, before pp_job_room_restore: one group of a class the setup defines here beside the class's
# largest. The engine's start trimmed the setup's groups alike; this brings the group back to its setup size from
# the peasants, within the class's open jobs, and notes what it took (pp_job_room_done_<class>).
pp_job_room_group = {
	if = {
		limit = { pp_job_room_left_$pop$ > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_job_room_want value = $size$ }
		random_pop = {
			limit = { pop_type = pop_type:$pop$ culture = culture:$culture$ religion = religion:$religion$ }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_job_room_want value = { value = $size$ subtract = pop_size min = 0 } }
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_job_room_move value = { value = scope:pp_job_room_want max = pp_job_room_left_$pop$ } }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_job_room_move > 0.0005 }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_job_room_share value = { value = scope:pp_job_room_move divide = { value = num_pop_type:peasants min = 0.001 } max = 0.9 } }
			every_pop = {
				limit = { pop_type = pop_type:peasants }
				split_pop = { fraction = scope:pp_job_room_share type = pop_type:$pop$ culture = culture:$culture$ religion = religion:$religion$ }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pp_job_room_done_$pop$ }
				change_variable = { name = pp_job_room_done_$pop$ add = scope:pp_job_room_move }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = pp_job_room_done_$pop$ value = scope:pp_job_room_move }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Location scope, once: $size$ thousand laborers back to the peasants; never more than the laborers idle
# here, and never below $keep$ thousand laborers outside the buildings. The pops setup holds the laborers
# outside the buildings, but not below the people the RGO's own starting size needs; where that leaves the
# setup short the game's start promotes four times the shortfall too many (job_room.start_laborer_plan),
# fewer where the peasants ran out. Every laborer pop gives the same share and keeps its culture and religion.
pp_job_room_trim = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_job_room_spare value = { value = num_pop_type:laborers subtract = pp_job_room_at_work_laborers subtract = $keep$ min = 0 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_job_room_move value = { value = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:laborers)" max = $size$ max = scope:pp_job_room_spare } }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_job_room_move > 0.0005 }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_job_room_share value = { value = scope:pp_job_room_move divide = { value = num_pop_type:laborers min = 0.001 } max = 0.9 } }
		every_pop = {
			limit = { pop_type = pop_type:laborers }
			split_pop = { fraction = scope:pp_job_room_share type = pop_type:peasants }
		}
	}
}
